title: How to Activate Sales Representative Tracking
text:
## How to Activate Sales Representative Tracking
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000058393
Within the BD platform, it is possible to activate Sales Representative Tracking for members.
To activate this feature, navigate to Settings >> Advanced Settings and search for:
Enable Sales Rep Field In Edit Members Form
System Variable: enable_sales_rep_field
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647160/original/eDR6uyUSFpkmA9V6kGzD7JBX2DWzqWdovw.png?1753160933 | alt: ]
When activated, a new search field called Choose Sales Rep Name will be available under My Members > > Search Members:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12094777744/original/jBBv010n6JK7ovNTIkgKsTyDDzkIyy6tVA.png?1624973520 | alt: ]
Also, a new filter will be added in the Finance >> Transaction History section:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124676126/original/_fUrtJuffFElZC0elMVZz_P7chkYcLwDBA.png?1682614478 | alt: ]
Assign a Sales Rep for each member by clicking on the Quick Edit option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12094777816/original/Ly_Gm7ScBnOsuNCeM_Q5n51RbxbQx5obDA.png?1624973573 | alt: ]
And assign a Sales Rep directly under the Sales Representative field:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12094777874/original/u9X7TLVmsS-fur35LWPJxOxYkJIUX0_aDg.png?1624973625 | alt: ]
This system name for the sales rep value is ref_code
Now this information added will display as a dropdown option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12094777979/original/gGwXOnpQbAl6ppMUoWgU9zFm380D3rrCBg.png?1624973698 | alt: ]
Important Note: This field will be available as a column when Exporting Member Results as well.
